subject: Hightower — request for penetration test report and scope clarification
messages:
From: Alicia Rey <alicia.rey@hightowercap.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: security@hightowercap.com
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0500
Subject: Request: pen test report + scope after service anomaly (INC-2026-078)

Marcus —

We noticed an increase in anomalous traffic to our staging API integration with Redwood last night and our SOC flagged it to compliance as part of INC-2026-078. Our auditors are asking for the most recent penetration test report that touches the inference runtime and networking boundary between Redwood and customer integrations.

Can you share:
- The last PT report you performed that includes external-facing API surface and VPC/networking (redacted if needed)
- The exact scope (IP ranges, environments, excluded components) and whether the incident area was in scope
- Current remediation status for any findings affecting external API access

We need this for a regulatory readout next Tuesday — can you provide the report (or a redacted summary) within 48 hours? If there are contractual or NDA steps required, please let us know immediately.

Thanks,
Alicia Rey
Director, Security Operations
Hightower Capital

Attachments: Hightower-INC-2026-078-log-sample.txt (referenced)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Rey <alicia.rey@hightowercap.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, security@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + scope after service anomaly (INC-2026-078)

Hi Alicia —

Thanks for flagging this and sharing the incident id. I understand the timing pressure for your regulatory readout. We performed a full engagement with an external firm in Nov 2025 that includes the inference runtime and perimeter API. Because the full report contains red team narratives and partner-sourced vuln details, our standard practice is to provide a redacted copy plus a findings summary.

Quick answers:
- Engagement date: November 12–16, 2025 (external firm: GreyLark Security).
- Scope: external API endpoints, gateway routing, auth token exchange, and a dedicated subset of customer-facing inference hosts (staged and prod); internal admin consoles and third-party infra were out of scope.
- Whether the area you mentioned is in scope: based on the log samples you sent, the integration endpoint is within the tested API surface.

I can share a redacted PDF and a one-page remediation status table within 24 hrs. If you require the unredacted report we will need either a signed NDA or a scoped SOC2/SIG exchange; you mentioned auditors — is your procurement OK with an NDA?

Attaching a short redwood-pt-summary-2025.pdf (summary + planned redactions).

Would you prefer a short call (15–30m) this afternoon to walk through the findings?

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-pt-summary-2025.pdf

From: Alicia Rey <alicia.rey@hightowercap.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: security@hightowercap.com, eng-jones@hightowercap.com
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 12:07:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + scope after service anomaly (INC-2026-078)

Marcus —

Thanks for the quick reply and the summary — that helps. Our compliance team is going to push for the full (unredacted) findings because our regulator requires raw CVE/POC references for systems that touched customer data. We can execute an NDA immediately; attaching the signed copy from our legal team (Hightower-NDA-signed.pdf).

If you need additional identification for our auditors, please let me know — we can provide a notarized letter or a Redacted-Access form if that helps.

Please let me know the next steps and if any internal approvals are needed on your side.

Alicia

Attachments: Hightower-NDA-signed.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 13:02:00 -0500
Subject: Fwd: Hightower — request for penetration test report and scope clarification

Team — forwarding an urgent request from Hightower (INC-2026-078). They signed an NDA and want the unredacted findings for regulator review. Key asks: full PT report that touches customer-facing API and a mapping of scope vs their integration.

Proposed plan:
1) Security to validate the NDA and confirm whether we can disclose unredacted report to an external auditor under our policy. If not, propose a minimally redacted extraction that includes CVE ids and mitigation steps but removes exploit POCs and partner-identified secrets.
2) Legal (Marissa) to confirm contract/insurance exposure and any required indemnities.
3) I will prepare a one-page mapping (which endpoints were tested vs their integration) and a remediation status table (showing which findings were fixed, in-progress, or planned).

Timeline: they want something within 48 hrs. I can get the mapping and status table ready in ~6 hours if security gives guidance on redaction.

Attaching a draft redaction_plan_draft.txt for review. Please advise ASAP.

—Marcus

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Rey <alicia.rey@hightowercap.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, security@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 16:42:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + scope clarification — redacted report and remediation update

Hi Alicia —

Appreciate your patience while we validated the NDA and scoped disclosures with our security and legal teams. Attached is a redacted copy of the Nov 2025 engagement that includes CVE identifiers and remediation actions but omits exploit POCs and tester identities as agreed by our legal team.

Summary of remediation status relevant to your integration:
- Finding 1 (token replay potential): patched and deployed 2025-12-18; mitigations verified in staging and prod.
- Finding 2 (rate-limiting bypass, external API): mitigation implemented as a config change 2026-01-09; additional hardening scheduled for 2026-03-05.
- Finding 3 (third-party dependency CVE affecting optional connector): vendor patch applied; we isolated the connector from live traffic on 2026-02-14.

Per our earlier notes, the engagement included the external API hostpool that aligns with the endpoints in your log samples. If your auditors need direct access to raw test artifacts, we can set up an auditor-only view via a controlled SSO link and temporary access token; that would require a short access agreement and time-boxed credentials.

Deliverables attached: redacted-pt-report-hightower-2025.pdf and a one-page mapping table (also included in the PDF). We also uploaded the deliverables to a secure drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleRedacted.

If you want to schedule a 20m technical walkthrough with our CISO and the engagement lead, I'm available tomorrow morning (Wed 9–11am ET).

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachments: redacted-pt-report-hightower-2025.pdf
